assignments.reason: The essential nature of this node is the extraction/clarification of sparks from the klipot — the cosmic function that defines the commerce domain. Package 1 already contains קדשות נפולות, ניצוצות שנפלו, and שמנשאין ומרימין הדבר (the act of lifting and restoring). The birur (extraction) of sparks is the same essential activity: it IS what commerce does at its deepest level. While the Torah states that this extraction happens THROUGH faith (eitza from אמונה), the extraction process itself — separating holy sparks from shells — shares the same essential nature as the lifting/restoring that defines משא ומתן. Assigned by essential nature, not by causal connection.
